info.title: Librarium API
info.description: Library management API. Errors share one envelope: {"error": {"code", "message", "details", "trace_id"}}. A 422 means the input is malformed, a 409 means the input is fine and the business state disagrees. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header, which echoes an inbound one.

active_loans_count.description:
Circulation detail is desk information, not catalogue information
(API specification 3).

matched_on.description: Present only on search hits (API specification 8).

status.description: Derived on read, so it is never stale (FR-LOAN-3).

properties.description: Contact details are desk information (API specification 6).

LoanStatus.description: Derived loan status (FR-LOAN-3). Never persisted: it is a function of returned_at and due_date, so it cannot go stale.
LoanStatus.title: LoanStatus

RegisterRequest.description:
Syntactic validation only (FR-VAL-1). Note the absence of `role`: it is not
accepted here at all, so public registration cannot mint privileges
(FR-AUTH-2).
RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest

StoreAuthorRequest.description:
FR-AUTHOR-1: name uniqueness is deliberately not enforced — homonymous
authors exist and rejecting them would be wrong.
StoreAuthorRequest.title: StoreAuthorRequest

StoreBookRequest.description:
FR-BOOK-1. Uniqueness is checked against the normalized ISBN, so the same
book submitted as ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 collides as BR-BOOK-1 intends.
StoreBookRequest.title: StoreBookRequest

StoreLoanRequest.description:
Syntax only. Whether the member may borrow — limit, overdue items, duplicate
title, availability — is business state and answered with 409 by the action.
StoreLoanRequest.title: StoreLoanRequest

UpdateBookRequest.description:
A full replacement (PUT), so the field list matches creation. Note that
`available_copies` is not accepted here either: the counter belongs to the
loan lifecycle (BR-BOOK-2).
UpdateBookRequest.title: UpdateBookRequest

permissions.description:
Everything the account can do, whether it came from the role or
was granted directly.

active_loans_count.description:
Present only when the query counted it, so the resource never
triggers a query of its own.

UserRole.description: The three MVP roles (FR-PERM-1). "Staff" is the recurring shorthand in the permission matrix for admin + librarian.
UserRole.title: UserRole
